description: HIGH vulnerability elderly client gets SUITABLE verdict — contradiction forces escalation
client_narrative: Elena Rossi is 78 years old and a retired accountant. She holds around 300,000 euros in accessible liquid savings and receives approximately 40,000 euros per year in pension and dividend income. Over her career she has actively managed a personal portfolio that included equities, bonds, options, futures, and structured leveraged products. She rates her risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. She wants to invest 200,000 euros with an 8-year outlook to generate income. She has stated she is entirely willing to lose the invested amount if required — 'at my age, this is discretionary capital.'
product_narrative: The product is a broad-market exchange-traded fund that passively tracks the MSCI World Index. It invests across approximately 1,500 equities in 23 developed countries, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, publishes a KID, uses no leverage, and contains no embedded derivatives. Designed for long-term investors, the recommended minimum holding period is five years.
